effects.effect:
Your [Mantle of Essence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.elementalist.level-4/mantle-of-essence) feature no longer requires essence.

Additionally, your [Mantle of Essence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.elementalist.level-4/mantle-of-essence) now radiates magic that creates a calming air. Creatures in the area of the mantle's [aura](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/aura) have their starting patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5) during any negotiation. While in the area, you and any ally gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) that use the [Handle Animals](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.interpersonal/handle-animals) skill. If you have 5 or more [Victories](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/victories), the [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to patience increases to 2 and [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) that use the [Handle Animals](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.interpersonal/handle-animals) skill have a double [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge).
